caption: ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different r with Gazeta dataset
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters and different r values on the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis, labeled "logr", has a logarithmic scale, a value range of 0 to approximately 9, and no units are present; tick labels are numeric and spaced at irregular intervals. The y-axis, labeled "ROUGE-1", has a linear scale, a value range of 0 to 35, and no units are present; tick labels are numeric and spaced at regular intervals of 5. The plot contains four lines: a red line for T5 + LoRA, a purple line for MBart + LoRA, a green line for T5 + AdaLoRA, and an orange line for MBart + AdaLoRA. The red line starts at approximately 23 and remains steady around 24 across the x-axis. The purple line starts at approximately 8, declines to around 4, then increases sharply to around 23 at logr 4, and remains steady around 24 afterwards. The green line starts at approximately 24 and remains steady around 30 across the x-axis. The orange line starts at approximately 6, increases sharply to around 32 at logr 4, and remains steady around 33 afterwards.
